_readme: Boosters of the current build (steps boosters2 + glue-intro + prelevel; docs/BOOSTERS.md for the original design, docs/PRELEVEL-STATUS.md for the pre-level offer). Only TNT is a charge on L1-36 (tntOnly).

A booster is the reward for beating a boss: won on L10 / L20 / L30, introduced and first usable on L11 / L21 / L31 with an 'Unlocked!' card, 'Claim x2' (2 free uses) and a forced first use. The tray shows locked 'Lv.N' slots from L1 (polish step hides locked chips in play).
Pre-level offer: before a Hard (purple) or Boss (orange) level a popup offers the 3 boosters (owned count / + to buy / locked Lv.N); each pick spends 1 use at level start.

boosters.name: Wrecking Ball
boosters.what: aim view; 1 use = 2 throws of a heavy ball that smashes members it hits

boosters.name: Safety Net
boosters.what: fences that catch debris on BLAST (protects neighbours / street); does not hold buildings

boosters.name: Sky Strike
boosters.what: tap a building: a strike from above drops and breaks members

notInTray.tnt1: +1 TNT: lose-card rescue only (rewarded ad / Fail Offer)

pocketUpgrade: Booster Pocket upgrade grants 1-3 free boosters when a Hard / Boss level opens
